mapper.sql: w.id,w.title,w.media_type AS mediaType,w.release_year AS releaseYear,w.synopsis,w.source,w.external_id AS externalId,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(g.name ORDER BY g.name SEPARATOR ' · ') FROM work_genre wg JOIN genre g ON g.id=wg.genre_id WHERE wg.work_id=w.id) AS genreNames

where.if: AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM work_genre wg WHERE wg.work_id=w.id AND wg.genre_id=#{q.genreId})

mapper.select: SELECT FROM work w ORDER BY w.created_at DESC,w.id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT FROM work w WHERE w.id=#{id}
SELECT id,name FROM genre ORDER BY name,id
SELECT genre_id FROM work_genre WHERE work_id=#{id} ORDER BY genre_id
SELECT id,title,media_type AS mediaType,release_year AS releaseYear FROM work WHERE title=#{title} AND media_type=#{mediaType} ORDER BY id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE genre SET name=#{name} WHERE id=#{id}
